headline.definition: Production-weighted mean of the panel yield anomalies over the crop seasons with a usable weather-implied estimate (at least half the window run, standard error under 40 points, positive leave-one-year-out skill over the trend-only baseline). The index-implied figure is the paper's medium-scenario change aggregated over exactly the same seasons with the same weights. A mixture of crops weighted by tonnes, not a global food-supply estimate.

scenario.note: CPC September 2026 outlook quantiles, divided by 1.178 to the relative index; 2015-16 monthly shape

refresh.summary: Weather updated through 30 September. Corrected the growing-season year for 2027 harvests and the reported uncertainty of weather-based estimates.
changes: Added five days of rainfall and matched temperature observations beyond the September issue.
Matched current weather to each crop's actual harvest year, including seasons planted in 2026 and harvested in 2027.
Computed the standard error of each panel estimate using the full coefficient covariance and the percent-change transformation.
Matched weather and ENSO results to the same crop-season series in unit map tooltips.
Retained September ENSO observations and the 10 September outlook; the next official outlook was not yet available on the release date.
Removed overlapping lower-priority sources from production denominators and excluded records without a fitted ENSO response; missing responses are no longer counted as zero impact.

coverage.definition: Production denominators include series with a fitted ENSO response, after source priority: HarvestStat, Hultgren, then national FAOSTAT. Missing responses are excluded rather than assigned zero impact.
